# `dotnet_diagnostic.ide0055.severity`

Set this to none to opt a file out of formatting.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `none` |  |
| `silent` |  |
| `suggestion` |  |
| `warning` |  |
| `error` |  |

**Default:** `warning`

## Examples

The snippet below is formatted with default options and then again with the option applied.

**Snippet (formatted with defaults):**

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; set; }

    public int Double()
    {
        return Value * 2;
    }
}
```

### `dotnet_diagnostic.ide0055.severity = none`

```ini
dotnet_diagnostic.ide0055.severity = none
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*
